feature_schema.core_scope: Prospective temporal/role/physical-graph descriptors; no widths, ranks, residuals, costs, labels or IDs.
feature_schema.full_oracle: legal AND gain_sign==1; an exact diagnostic upper bound, not a trainable predictor.
feature_schema.gain_sign: For legal pairs only: +1 strict concave-moment improvement, 0 tie, -1 harm. Illegal gain_sign is 0.
feature_schema.mechanism_scope: Explicitly width/residual/capacity-derived comparator; not rank-free ML.

protocol.features: core rank/price-free columns; optional six width/residual/capacity columns explicitly cost-derived
protocol.joint_split: same global salted hash namespace for call IDs and physical-family IDs; train all four endpoints in side0, test all four in side1; discard mixed rows
protocol.pair_purge: remove from other-fill training every canonical role pair present anywhere in held-out fill before sampling; report degeneration
protocol.permutation_null: Within each fixed source-fill x S-flag benchmark-panel block, shuffle exact binary labels, keeping pairs/features/weights and block class counts fixed. One-class blocks unchanged. Tests conditional within-block feature-label association in this finite related lineage only.
protocol.permutation_reporting: unshuffled matched benchmark and 2000 indexed shuffle statistics; no p/q, pattern, independence, causal or best-model claim
protocol.permutation_secondary_statistic: same Brier difference against train-within-S prevalence and zero outsideS; guards against credit merely for identifying the necessary-gain stratum
protocol.permutation_statistic: mean over three held-out fills of weighted Brier(training mean)-weighted Brier(model), separately core_linear/core_quadratic
protocol.preprocessing: train-only inverse-inclusion-weighted means/scales; clip standardized x to [-8,8]; quadratic appends x*x; no feature selection
protocol.relatedness: Three allocations share ancestry; entire-fill holdout is a sensitivity, not independent replication.
protocol.subsampling: label-blind fixed salted SplitMix64 pair hash, choose smallest hashes; include exact N/n retention factor; no adaptive cap
protocol.target: legal AND gain_sign==+1; strict exact complete-profile improvement, not kappa admission
protocol.training_weights: inverse inclusion and label-blind subsampling; balance each class to one half for fitting; restore training population-prior log odds at prediction
